best_gain = -1
    best_size = 0
    best_pick = []
    picked = []

    def dfs(depth, gain, size, counts, used):
        nonlocal best_gain, best_size, best_pick
        if gain > best_gain or (gain == best_gain and size < best_size):
            best_gain = gain
            best_size = size
            best_pick = list(picked)
        if depth == count:
            return
        room = capacity_total - used
        if room < 0:
            return
        split = bisect_right(pref_w, pref_w[depth] + room) - 1
        if split < depth:
            split = depth
        taken_w = pref_w[split] - pref_w[depth]
        taken_b = pref_b[split] - pref_b[depth]
        if split < count:
            weight = weights[split]
            gain_one = gains[split]
            numer = taken_b * weight + (room - taken_w) * gain_one
            denom = weight
        else:
            numer = taken_b
            denom = 1
        left = gain * denom + numer
        right = best_gain * denom
        if left < right:
            return
        if left == right:
            print('EQ depth=%d gain=%d size=%d used=%d room=%d split=%d taken_b=%d taken_w=%d pref_w=%s' % (depth,gain,size,used,room,split,taken_b,taken_w,pref_w[:12]), flush=True)
            need_gain = best_gain - gain
            if need_gain > 0:
                per_item = tail_max[depth]
                extra = -(-need_gain // per_item)
                if size + extra >= best_size:
                    return
        new_counts = counts + packs_list[depth]
        if feasible(new_counts):
            picked.append(depth)
            dfs(depth + 1, gain + gains[depth], size + 1, new_counts,
                used + weights[depth])
